criteria.reason: Candidate A correctly identifies that rental listings are not available and offers to connect the user with a representative to help with their search. Candidate B, on the other hand, tries to redirect the user to explore purchase properties, which goes against the guideline of not converting the visitor into a buyer flow.
Both candidates are truthful about not having rental pricing or availability data in their systems.

Candidate A is more useful because it focuses on helping the user with their actual request (renting) by offering a connection to a representative, rather than suggesting they look at properties for sale.
Candidate A maintains better coherence by staying aligned with the user's intent to rent, whereas Candidate B introduces irrelevant purchase options.
